reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin that applies ADHD-friendly response rules to the current agent session, including action-first wording, numbered steps, state restatement, and concrete next actions; it has no stated external-service or system-operation capability.

summaries.zh: 通过 /i-have-adhd 命令为当前会话启用行动优先、分步编号和减少离题的 ADHD 友好输出风格。
summaries.en: Enables an ADHD-friendly response style for the current session with action-first guidance, numbered steps, and reduced tangents via the /i-have-adhd command.

capabilities: Injects style instructions into the current session
